description: The plot illustrates the relationship between an unspecified variable on the x-axis and two metrics, Recall@50 and NDCG@50, on the y-axes. The x-axis is labeled with integer values from 1 to 5, with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 1. The left y-axis represents Recall@50, ranging from 0.30 to 0.60 with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 0.05, while the right y-axis represents NDCG@50, ranging from 0.15 to 0.22 with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 0.01. The plot displays four lines: Recall@50 (Ours) in solid green, Recall@50 (ReFICR) in dashed green, NDCG@50 (Ours) in solid blue, and NDCG@50 (ReFICR) in dashed blue. Recall@50 (Ours) starts at approximately 0.34 at x=1 and increases to around 0.49 at x=5, with a notable rise between x=1 and x=3. Recall@50 (ReFICR) remains steady at approximately 0.47 across the x-axis range. NDCG@50 (Ours) begins at about 0.16 at x=1 and rises to around 0.185 at x=4, before leveling off. NDCG@50 (ReFICR) remains constant at approximately 0.158 across the x-axis range.
